title: The Hom functor from a finite locally free source to a separated locally quasi-finite target is representable by a scheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For morphisms Z -> S and X -> S of schemes with Z -> S finite locally free and X -> S separated and locally quasi-finite, the functor Mor_S(Z, X) is representable by a scheme. The retained proof is the two named chapter lemmas and nothing else: lemma hom-from-finite-locally-free-representable (registered by lane S9 as S9-morph-hom-locally-free-representable) gives representability of the Hom stack by a scheme when the source is finite locally free, and lemma separated-locally-quasi-finite-over-affine (this lane, card S3-morph-separated-locally-quasi-finite-over-affine) supplies the separated-locally-quasi-finite input that keeps the representing object a scheme on affine bases; the author adds no further argument. Retained author proof at lines 20264-20268.
